facts.value: The short lookup literals used by bootOnLeave are company identifier "01" and language-selected product identifiers "GPIJ" and "GPIE". The card channel is the separate integer argument 0. Their compiled section placement is not established by the source.

Category initialization, regional exclusion and lazy loading.

facts.rationale: Preserves exact guards and unconditional routing while distinguishing the low-byte query from unlock flags and specifying the preparatory call's actual behavior.
facts.value: The trophy branch runs only when Toy_803048C0(TROPHY_PIKMIN), which reads the trophy record's low byte, returns zero. It probes channel 0 for the language-selected Pikmin save. A zero probe result calls Toy_803124BC and then Toy_SetUnlockState(TROPHY_PIKMIN, true); otherwise neither update occurs. Toy_803124BC initializes eligible category-2 availability flags, including regional exclusions and lazy table loading. Regardless of the trophy branch, the callback installs lbCardGame_DecideGameMode as the override and requests the exit payload's mode_id.
